Coram : ALTAMAS KABIR*, MUKUNDAKAM SHARMA
Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 - s. 12(a) - C Complaint against police officials - Alleging physical torture of complainant's son in police custody - State Human Rights Commission held that police personnel were responsible for violation of human rights and recommended compensation - State the Commission o - Writ petition against order of the Commission dismissed - On appeal, held: finding by the Commission and High Court regarding the torture of the complainant's son in police custody, is justified - There is no material to refute the complaint of torture. E Respondent No. 1
Decision Date : 28-07-2010 | Case No : SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) No. 6408/2006 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
